BiblicalUsage: giddûwph is the word for revilings, reviling words. I meet it 3 times across the Bible, and Isaiah is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe giddûwph matters because God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
